posts.title: Compose UI without an Activity
posts.description: Recently, I needed to add a custom marker to a MapLibre map with the upcoming street name, while respecting various rules (supporting RTL, etc). Inspired by our iOS team, I solved this by writing the street name marker code in Compose, and then taking a screenshot of the Composable on demand and rendering it to the map.
